Metadata.title: ToPWR | Your student assistant
Metadata.description: First day of classes and it's already an odd Wednesday on a Monday? A building with the cryptic name C-13 in your timetable? Or maybe you're looking for information about faculties and student research groups? Every student at WUST asks similar questions, so we know how hard it is to get a handle on university life. We created ToPWR to simplify everyday student challenges!

isFree.question: Is ToPWR free?
isFree.answer: Yes — ToPWR is completely free and ad-free. Get it from the App Store and Google Play with no fees, subscriptions or hidden costs.
